20248.long_desc:
INTRODUCTORY OFFER - LIMITED TIME The Arcooda 21.3 inch 4:3 aspect ratio monitor with integrated speakers offers a premium solution for industrial, commercial, arcade, retro and digital art installations. Supporting 15khz, 24khz, and 31khz signals native inputs up to 1600x1200, with 1.7ms display lag, 500nits brightness and 1800:1 contrast, this monitor delivers authentic 4x3 aspect visuals while offering modern connectivity and multimedia functionality. Built-In Speakers for Complete Audio-Visual Setup This upgraded model includes integrated stereo speakers, making it ideal for digital signage, art displays, interactive exhibits, or home gaming. Supports both internal speakers, or connect external speakers. Full Connectivity Choose from VGA, DVI, HDMI and DisplayPort inputs, as well as RGB input via the RGB board (optional). Supports DDC/CI and control your inputs and monitor settings via your PC. ARCADE MACHINE & GAMING INDUSTRY
  • Supports multiple variations of 15khz, 25kz, 31khz, arcade gaming resolutions.
  • latest firmware, over 10 years of constant firmware upgrades offering the widest possible support for most arcade game boards on "plug and play basis". From Sega Model 2 and 3 game boards, to Neo Geo, Namco System 256, Sega Triforce and your standard JAMMA arcade game boards.
  • auto picture function that works, tuned with real arcade game boards. Just press the auto button for perfect centering of your arcade picture.
  • multiple mounting options including angle brackets (included) rear mounting connection, and VESA mount. This offers the widest mounting options.
  • breakout OSD monitor control board (optional). Mount the monitor adjustment board where it matters, in front of you.
  • RGB adapter PCB (optional) for plug and play with almost any CRT tube monitor wiring. This board also offers fine tuning of color via red,blue,green color potentiometers
  • full angle viewing is perfect for all arcade machines.
  • multiple screen adjustments including picture rotate function.
    • HOME RETRO & PC GAMING
  • over 160 pre-programmed PC input modes including 240p, 480p, 720p, up to 1600x1200
  • offering full display angle viewing with 16.7M color reproduction, 1800:1 contrast ratio
  • VESA mounting for easy desktop mounting
  • connect breakout speakers via the 3.5mm audio jack
    • DIGITAL DISPLAY & DESKTOP PC
  • High brightness function up to 500nits with true 4:3 aspect ratio
  • Multiple inputs including VGA, DVI, HDMI and DisplayPort
  • Multiple mounting options including VESA (for any desktop stand or wall mount) and bracket (for your custom installation)
  • Audio output – 2x 10watt output via 3.5mm.
  • DDC/CI monitor support The Arcooda 21.3inch 4:3 ratio LCD monitor has been designed for multiple industries including industrial control systems, military, digital media including photography and videography, retro gaming, and highly suitable for arcade machines (full viewing angle, brightness and low resolution support). Custom frame and features are possible for OEM bulk orders included special mounting solutions.
